title: T H I C C item case

infobox.effect: Provides 196 inventory slots while only taking up 15

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- Cannot be stored in a backpack.

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The T H I C C item case is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 196 inventory slots in a 14x14 grid and only takes up 15 inventory slots itself. It can store everything except:
- Item case
- T H I C C item case
- Weapon case
- T H I C C Weapon case
- Lucky Scav Junk box
- Some special equipment

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text: - 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from A Difficult Choice

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- "T H I C C" is a reference to the slang term thicc. The implication is that the case is wider than the normal case.
- Easter eggs and References: The is modeled after the 1780 Protector Transport Case by Pelican.
